top_choice_rationale: P002 rewards a quantitative prediction (the 2011 Bistritzer-MacDonald continuum model of flat bands at a magic twist angle) followed by the 2018 discovery of correlated insulators and superconductivity at that angle, since reproduced by many independent laboratories. It establishes a new tunable platform for strongly correlated electrons with a clean model-experiment link, and the citation can rest on the established flat band and phases rather than the open pairing mechanism. The laureate allocation (theory pair plus experimental leader) maps cleanly, though first authors such as Cao cannot be named. I accept the maturity objection and rank the better-settled lattice clock P001 second, well above no award, since it is independently reproduced and fundamentally consequential.
